info.title: DiffToJson
info.description:
A CLI for detecting and serializing Git commit Diffs and commit messages from a local Git repository to a JSONL file.

This can be useful for preparing git commit diffs and message data for training AI/ML models or similar use cases.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Detects and Serializes Git Diffs and Commits to a .JSONL file.

options.name: --repo-directory
options.description: The local git repository directory. Falls back to the current directory if not provided. [default: <path>]

options.name: --repo-url
options.description: The URL of the git repository. [default: ]

options.name: --model-id
options.description: The model id of the AI model to use [default: ]

options.name: --endpoint-url
options.description: The endpoint URL of the OpenAI compatible API endpoint to use. [default: ]

options.name: --provider
options.description: The Id of the AI provider to use. [default: ]

options.name: --api-key
options.description: The API key of the AI provider to use. [default: ]

options.name: --license
options.description: The licence name to use for the JSON. [default: ]

options.name: --output
options.description: The output file path. If not specified, the default is the repository directory path. [default: ]

options.name: --format
options.description: The output format. 'training' produces camelCase JSONL for AI training; 'raw' produces the legacy PascalCase JSONL. [default: training]

options.name: --prompt-style
options.description: The prompt preset to use for training records. [default: default]

options.name: --system-prompt
options.description: Override the system prompt template. Supports placeholders: {diff}, {commitMessage}, {repoName}, {license}, {repoUrl}. [default: ]

options.name: --user-prompt
options.description: Override the user prompt template. Supports placeholders: {diff}, {commitMessage}, {repoName}, {license}, {repoUrl}. [default: ]

options.name: --llm-assistant-output
options.description: Enable LLM-generated assistant messages for each commit. Requires --provider, --model-id, --api-key, and --endpoint-url. [default: False]

options.name: --llm-override-prompt
options.description: Override the user prompt sent to the LLM when --llm-assistant-output is enabled. Supports placeholders. [default: ]

options.name: --reasoning-effort
options.description: The reasoning effort level used by the AI model. Valid values: auto, on, off, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Valid values depend on the active (provider, model). [default: auto]

options.name: --redaction
options.description: PII redaction tier for training records. 'none' disables redaction; 'message' redacts only commit messages; 'diff' redacts only diffs; 'all' redacts both. [default: message]
